topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series context and outlines the key learning outcomes regarding cancer evolution.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how pre-malignant tissues undergo clonal selection through successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the role of cellular differentiation hierarchies and evaluate evidence for cancer stem cells across hematological and intestinal tissues.

topics.label: Microenvironmental promotion and stromal dependency
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external promoters, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma cooperate with mutations to drive tumor growth and progression.

topics.label: Technologies for analyzing tumor evolution and architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial technologies used to resolve tumor heterogeneity and evolutionary trajectories.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes the interplay among mutational burden, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental conditions required for malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next steps
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapy.
